an11.11:1.5: “I hear that several mendicants are making a robe for the Buddha, thinking:
an11.11:1.6: ‘When his robe is finished and the three months of the rains residence have passed, the Buddha will set out wandering.’”
an11.11:4.4: At that time their mind is quite unswerving, based on the teaching.
an11.11:4.5: A noble disciple whose mind is unswerving finds inspiration in the meaning and the teaching, and finds joy connected with the teaching.
an11.11:4.6: When they’re joyful, rapture springs up. When the mind is full of rapture, the body becomes tranquil. When the body is tranquil, they feel bliss. And when they’re blissful, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
an11.11:5.4: At that time their mind is quite unswerving, based on the Saṅgha.
an11.11:5.5: A noble disciple whose mind is unswerving finds inspiration in the meaning and the teaching, and finds joy connected with the teaching.
an11.11:5.6: When they’re joyful, rapture springs up. When the mind is full of rapture, the body becomes tranquil. When the body is tranquil, they feel bliss. And when they’re blissful, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
an11.11:6.3: At that time their mind is quite unswerving, based on their ethical conduct.
an11.11:6.4: A noble disciple whose mind is unswerving finds inspiration in the meaning and the teaching, and finds joy connected with the teaching.
an11.11:6.5: When they’re joyful, rapture springs up. When the mind is full of rapture, the body becomes tranquil. When the body is tranquil, they feel bliss. And when they’re blissful, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
an11.11:7.5: At that time their mind is quite unswerving, based on their generosity.
an11.11:7.6: A noble disciple whose mind is unswerving finds inspiration in the meaning and the teaching, and finds joy connected with the teaching.
an11.11:7.7: When they’re joyful, rapture springs up. When the mind is full of rapture, the body becomes tranquil. When the body is tranquil, they feel bliss. And when they’re blissful, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
an11.11:8.4: When those deities passed away from here, they were reborn there because of their ethics. I, too, have the same kind of ethics.
an11.11:8.5: When those deities passed away from here, they were reborn there because of their learning. I, too, have the same kind of learning.
an11.11:8.6: When those deities passed away from here, they were reborn there because of their generosity. I, too, have the same kind of generosity.
an11.11:8.7: When those deities passed away from here, they were reborn there because of their wisdom. I, too, have the same kind of wisdom.’
